traits.name: Warforged Resilience
traits.desc: The warforged has advantage on saving throws against being poisoned. The warforged is immune to being put to sleep or diseased.

traits.name: Tactical Training
traits.desc: The warforged has advantage on initiative.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.desc: The warforged counts as one size larger for the purposes of carrying, pushing, and lifting.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.desc: The warforged deals double damage to buildings and objects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The warforged makes two attacks with its Hammer Fist. It can substitute any number of Hammer Fist attacks for a Heavy Cannon attack.

actions.name: Hammer Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. Upon a hit, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Heavy Cannon
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 60/120 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d4 + 4) piercing damage. Upon a hit, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pushed back 10 ft. All creatures within a 10 ft. radius around the target take half damage.

monsters.name: Tactical Unit G-18F22 'Intel'
monsters.languages: Common, and one language of choice

traits.name: Constructed Nature
traits.desc: The warforged has no need for food, drink, or air.

traits.name: Dauntless
traits.desc: The warforged has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

traits.name: Multi-limbed
traits.desc: When the warforged uses its reaction to make an opportunity attack, it can make two armblade attacks instead of one as part of that reaction.

traits.name: Warforged Resilience
traits.desc: The warforged has advantage on saving throws against being poisoned. The warforged is immune to being put to sleep or diseased.

traits.name: Reactive
traits.desc: The warforged can take a reaction at the end of every creature's turn.

traits.name: Tactical Training
traits.desc: The warforged has advantage on initiative.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The warforged makes four attacks with its armblade.

actions.name: Armblade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Blade Storm (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Creatures in a 5 ft. radius around the warforged must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed saving throw, creatures take 28 (8d6) slashing damage, or half as much on a successful one.

bonus_actions.name: Overcharged Step
bonus_actions.desc: As a bonus action, Intel can move up to their movement speed in an instant (similar to Misty Step).

legendary_actions.name: Legendary Actions (1/Turn)
legendary_actions.desc: Intel can take 1 legendary action per turn at the end of another creature's turn. Intel regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary_actions.name: Poison
legendary_actions.desc: Intel can inject 1 creature within melee striking distance of him with a viral poison. This inflicts the poisoned condition until it is removed with Greater Restoration.

legendary_actions.name: Armblade
legendary_actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.

legendary_actions.name: Overcharged Step
legendary_actions.desc: Intel can move up to their movement range in an instant (similar to Misty Step).

monsters.name: Awakened Unit M-29G06 'Stitch'
monsters.languages: Common, and one language of choice

traits.name: Dauntless
traits.desc: The warforged has advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

traits.name: Constructed Nature
traits.desc: The warforged has no need for food, drink, or air.

traits.name: Life Saver
traits.desc: The warforged can roll for the maximum value on its healing spells if it uses a healing spell on a creature at 0 hit points.

traits.name: Mending Triage
traits.desc: The warforged's healing spells can affect constructs and grant them additional temporary hit points equal to the amount of hit points recovered.

traits.name: Warforged Resilience
traits.desc: The warforged has advantage on saving throws against being poisoned. The warforged is immune to being put to sleep or diseased.

traits.name: Tactical Training
traits.desc: The warforged has advantage on initiative.

traits.name: Vitality Sensors
traits.desc: The warforged can determine if a creature within 60 ft. of it that it can see suffers from one of the following conditions: blinded, deafened, diseased, paralyzed, or poisoned.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The warforged is a 6th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit on spell attacks). It has the following spells prepared:
Cantrips (at will): Toll the Dead, Spare the Dying, Mending
1st Level (4 slots): Sanctuary, Command, Cure Wounds, Ray of Sickness, Inflict Wounds
2nd Level (3 slots): Hold Person, Silence
3rd Level (2 slots): Incite Greed, Aura of Vitality

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The warforged can cast a spell and make one attack with a sedative needle or vile needle.

actions.name: Sedative Needle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. Upon a hit, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or take 7 (2d6) poison damage and fall unconscious. On a successful saving throw, creatures take half damage and are otherwise unaffected. Creatures remain unconscious for 10 minutes or until it is damaged or a creature uses its action to wake it up.

actions.name: Vile Needle
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. Upon a hit, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed saving throw, creatures take 7 (2d6) poison damage and are poisoned until the end of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, creatures take half damage and are not poisoned.

traits.name: Constructed Nature
traits.desc: Overwatch has no need for food, drink, or air.

traits.name: Adaptable
traits.desc: Overwatch will gain damage resistance against an attack that has been used against him before, and damage immunity once to that damage type if the same attack is used twice in a row against him.

traits.name: Construct Resilience
traits.desc: Overwatch has advantage on saving throws against being poisoned. Overwatch is immune to being put to sleep or diseased.

traits.name: Defiance
traits.desc: Overwatch has advantage on saving throws against being frightened. If Overwatch is Frightened, it gains 10 temporary hit points at the start of each of its turns while it is not Incapacitated.

traits.name: Tactical Training
traits.desc: Overwatch has advantage on initiative.

traits.name: Tactical Strike
traits.desc: Once per turn, Overwatch can deal an extra 11 (3d6) damage to a creature it hits with a weapon attack if that creature is within 5 feet of an ally of Overwatch that isn't Incapacitated.

traits.name: Martial Flurry
traits.desc: Once on each of its turns, if Overwatch has advantage on an attack roll, it can make one additional weapon attack as part of that Attack action.

traits.name: Martial Overdrive (Recharge 5–6)
traits.desc: When Overwatch finishes its turn, it can take one additional turn immediately after.

traits.name: Phase 2
traits.desc: At 40 HP, Overwatch activates Overwatch Protocol. He glows blue under his chassis, and his attacks all deal 1 additional die of damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Overwatch makes three attacks with its armblade. It can substitute any number of armblade attacks with a hand cannon.

actions.name: Extending Arm Blade
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage. Upon a hit, a Medium or smaller target is pulled 10 ft. toward the commander.

actions.name: Rifle
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 120/240 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Tactical Command
bonus_actions.desc: Overwatch can grant a creature of its choice within 30 ft. advantage on its next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw until the end of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Legendary Actions (3/Round)
legendary_actions.desc: Commander Unit G-21T 'Overwatch' can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Overwatch regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary_actions.name: Disruption Protocol
legendary_actions.desc: Overwatch attempts to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell. If the creature is casting a spell of 3rd level or lower, its spell fails and has no effect. If it is casting a spell of 4th level or higher, Overwatch makes an ability check using its spellcasting ability (DC = 10 + the spell's level). On a success, the spell fails and has no effect.

legendary_actions.name: Overwatch Protocol
legendary_actions.desc: Grants Overwatch and any units under his command advantage on one attack for the entire round, and advantage on any one save over the next round. All attacks against Overwatch have disadvantage until the next round.

monsters.name: Angry Sorrowsworn
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing while in dim light or darkness

traits.name: Two Heads
traits.desc: The sorrowsworn has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, or knocked unconscious.

traits.name: Rising Anger
traits.desc: If another creature deals damage to the sorrowsworn, the sorrowsworn's attack rolls have advantage until the end of its next turn, and the first time it hits with a Hook attack on its next turn, the attack's target takes an extra 19 (3d12) psychic damage. On its turn, the sorrowsworn has disadvantage on attack rolls if no other creature has dealt damage to it since the end of its last turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sorrowsworn makes two Hook attacks.

actions.name: Hook
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d12 + 3) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Hungry Sorrowsworn
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing while in dim light or darkness

traits.name: Life Hunger
traits.desc: If a creature within 60 feet of the sorrowsworn regains hit points, the sorrowsworn gains two benefits until the end of its next turn: it has advantage on attack rolls, and its Bite deals an extra 22 (4d10) necrotic damage on a hit.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sorrowsworn makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) slashing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 16), and it is restrained until the grapple ends. While grappling a creature, the sorrowsworn can't make a Claw attack.

monsters.name: Lonely Sorrowsworn
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing while in dim light or darkness

traits.name: Psychic Leech
traits.desc: At the start of each of the sorrowsworn's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

traits.name: Thrives on Company
traits.desc: The sorrowsworn has advantage on attack rolls while it is within 30 feet of at least two other creatures. It otherwise has disadvantage on attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sorrowsworn makes one Harpoon Arm attack, and it uses Sorrowful Embrace.

actions.name: Harpoon Arm
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15) if it is a Large or smaller creature. The sorrowsworn has two harpoon arms and can grapple up to two creatures at once.

actions.name: Sorrowful Embrace
actions.desc: Each creature grappled by the sorrowsworn must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In either case, the sorrowsworn pulls each of those creatures up to 30 feet straight toward it.

monsters.name: Lost Sorrowsworn
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing while in dim light or darkness

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sorrowsworn makes two Arm Spike attacks.

actions.name: Arm Spike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Embrace (Recharge 4–6)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d10 + 3) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14) if it is a Medium or smaller creature. Until the grapple ends, the target is frightened, and it takes 27 (6d8) psychic damage at the end of each of its turns. The sorrowsworn can grapple only one creature at a time.

reactions.name: Tightening Embrace
reactions.desc: If the sorrowsworn takes damage, the creature grappled by Embrace takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage.

monsters.name: Wretched Sorrowsworn
monsters.damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing while in dim light or darkness

traits.name: Wretched Pack Tactics
traits.desc: The sorrowsworn has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the sorrowsworn's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated. The sorrowsworn otherwise has disadvantage on attack rolls.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage, and the sorrowsworn attaches to the target. While attached, the sorrowsworn can't attack, and at the start of each of the sorrowsworn's turns, the target takes 6 (1d10 + 1) necrotic damage. The attached sorrowsworn moves with the target whenever the target moves, requiring none of the sorrowsworn's movement. The sorrowsworn can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement on its turn. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the sorrowsworn.

traits.name: Aberrant Ground
traits.desc: The ground in a 10-foot radius around the mouther is doughlike difficult terrain. Each creature that starts its turn in that area must succeed on a DC 10 Strength saving throw or have its speed reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn.

traits.name: Cacophony
traits.desc: The king babbles incoherently while it can see any creature and isn't incapacitated. Each creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the king and can hear the babbling must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature can't take reactions until the start of its next turn and rolls a d8 to determine what it does during its turn. On a 1 to 4, the creature does nothing. On a 5 or 6, the creature takes no action or bonus action and uses all its movement to move in a randomly determined direction. On a 7 or 8, the creature makes a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach or does nothing if it can't make such an attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The King of the Ball makes one Bite attack, one Slam attack, and, if available, uses its The King's Light.

actions.name: Bites
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 17 (5d6) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it must succeed on a DC 10 Strength saving throw or be restrained. If the target is killed by this damage, it is absorbed into the mouther.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., affects target(s) in a 10 ft. line. Hit: 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage. A Medium or smaller creature must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: The King's Light (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The King emits a bright light from every orifice affecting all creatures that can see within 30 ft. of the king. Each creature within 30 ft. must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be blinded until the end of the mouther's next turn and take 28 (8d6) radiant damage.

bonus_actions.name: Shriek (Recharge 2–3)
bonus_actions.desc: Creatures within a 30-foot radius must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned.

bonus_actions.name: Bone Dart
bonus_actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (3d4) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Shield
reactions.desc: One of the twisted beings on the King's body casts the shield spell, granting a +5 bonus to AC until the start of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Legendary Actions (2/Round)
legendary_actions.desc: The King of the Ball can take 2 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The King regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary_actions.name: Slam
legendary_actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., affects target(s) in a 10 ft. line. Hit: 10 (3d6) bludgeoning damage. A Medium or smaller creature must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

legendary_actions.name: Consume
legendary_actions.desc: A nearby player must make a Dexterity check to save a ball-goer. If they fail, the King of the Ball absorbs a new ball-goer, regaining 14 (2d8 + 5) hit points.

monsters.name: Masquerade
monsters.languages: Common, Sylvan, any languages known by its stolen faces

traits.name: Multiple Dancers
traits.desc: The Masquerade takes the form of 5 Dancers, sharing a single HP pool. Hitting multiple dancers with the same attack does not multiply the damage. The dancers move independently on their turn.

traits.name: Illusory Appearance
traits.desc: The masquerade covers itself and anything it is wearing or carrying with a magical Illusion that makes it look like a creature whose face it has stolen. It can also perfectly mimic the creature's voice and inflections. The masquerade must wear the mask it has created of the creature's face in order to do so. The effect ends if the masquerade takes off the mask or dies. The changes wrought by this effect fail to hold up to physical inspection. Otherwise, a creature must take an action to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the masquerade is disguised.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The masquerade's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: dancing lights, message, silent image
3/day each: mirror image, misty step, pass without trace, silence
1/day each: fear, hold person, major image, nondetection

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The Masquerade can perform up to 5 attacks per round, one for each dancer. Only one of the attacks may be a leveled spell, while the rest must be weapon attacks.

actions.name: Waltz
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or take 22 (4d10) psychic damage and be stunned for 1 minute. A creature that succeeds on the saving throw takes half as much psychic damage and is not stunned. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Facesteal
actions.desc: The Masquerade initiates a Charisma contest with an incapacitated Small or Medium creature that has a face within 5 feet of it. If it wins the contest, the masquerade magically steals the creature's face, creating a mask with its visage. A creature without a face is blinded, deafened, and can't speak. If the mask of a creature's face is returned to it, the creature's face is magically restored.

legendary_actions.name: Legendary Actions (1/Round)
legendary_actions.desc: The Masquerade can take 1 legendary action per round, choosing from the option below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The Masquerade regains its spent legendary action at the start of its turn.

legendary_actions.name: Invitation!
legendary_actions.desc: One targeted creature must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or join the dance. A magic mask appears on their face, they are compelled to move on their turn in the dance, and they are unable to attack the dancers. All affected creatures may use their action to resist the dance, but whether successful or not, they must use their movement action before their action.

monsters.name: False Hydra
monsters.senses: blindsense 30 ft., tremorsense 240 ft., passive Perception 10

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: When the False Hydra fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Multiple Heads
traits.desc: The False Hydra has as many actions on its turn as it has heads, using one action per head. Each head can concentrate on a spell effect cast by the False Hydra, but that head must use its action each turn to concentrate on the effect. For every head beyond one, it has an extra reaction that can be used only to make opportunity attacks. While it has more than one head, the False Hydra has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, deafened, stunned, and knocked unconscious. If the False Hydra takes more than 40 damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. If its last head dies, it dies.

traits.name: Howl Of Oblivion
traits.desc: The False Hydra's heads can, as their action, sing a howling song that causes any who hear it within 5 miles to ignore the Hydra's presence. This extends to any secondary effects of the Hydra's presence, such as the song itself, evidence of the Hydra's presence, or even their memories of the people that the Hydra has killed. Children under 13 years of age are able to remember those killed by the Hydra.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The False Hydra's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 20). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring only verbal components:
1/day each: compulsion, confusion, dominate monster

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) piercing damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 19). While grappling a target, that head cannot Bite another target. If a Bite attack hits a creature already grappled by the head, the grapple ends and the creature is swallowed.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (1d12 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Mental Revolt (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The Hydra's heads combine to scream their song of mental domination. All creatures within 120 ft. of the Hydra's body must make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw, taking 34 (6d10) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. In addition, the False Hydra is invisible to any creature that fails this saving throw until it attacks that creature. Creatures can use their action to repeat the saving throw to end the invisibility effect. The Hydra cannot take other actions on a turn during which it uses this ability.

actions.name: Swallowed
actions.desc: While swallowed, a creature is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and effects outside the Hydra, and takes 17 (3d10) acid damage at the start of the False Hydra's turn. If the Hydra takes 20 damage or more during a round from creatures inside it, it must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone within 10 feet of the head that swallowed them.

actions.name: Retract Neck
actions.desc: The head is pulled twice its speed back toward the False Hydra's body. A grappled creature must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be pulled along with it. This movement can trigger opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Legendary Actions (3/Round)
legendary_actions.desc: The False Hydra can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The False Hydra regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary_actions.name: Detect
legendary_actions.desc: The False Hydra makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary_actions.name: Slam
legendary_actions.desc: The False Hydra makes one Slam attack.

legendary_actions.name: Cast Spell
legendary_actions.desc: One of the Hydra's heads casts a spell from its Innate Spellcasting list.

monsters.name: Adult Oblex
monsters.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this distance), passive Perception 14

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: The oblex can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Aversion to Fire
traits.desc: If the oblex takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The oblex's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 15). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:
3/day each: charm person (as 5th-level spell), color spray, detect thoughts, hold person (as 3rd-level spell)

traits.name: Sulfurous Impersonation
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the oblex can extrude a piece of itself that assumes the appearance of one Medium or smaller creature whose memories it has stolen. This simulacrum appears, feels, and sounds exactly like the creature it impersonates, though it smells faintly of sulfur. The oblex can impersonate 1d4 + 1 different creatures, each one tethered to its body by a strand of slime that can extend up to 120 feet away. For all practical purposes, the simulacrum is the oblex, meaning that the oblex occupies its space and the simulacrum's space simultaneously. The slimy tether is immune to damage, but it is severed if there is no opening at least 1 inch wide between the oblex's main body and the simulacrum. The simulacrum disappears if the tether is severed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The oblex makes one Pseudopod attack and uses Eat Memories.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) psychic damage.

actions.name: Eat Memories
actions.desc: The oblex targets one creature it can see within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 18 (4d8) psychic damage and become memory drained until it finishes a short or long rest or until it benefits from the greater restoration or heal spell. Constructs, oozes, plants, and undead succeed on the save automatically. While memory drained, the target must roll a d4 and subtract the number rolled from any ability check or attack roll it makes. Each time the target is memory drained beyond the first, the die size increases by one: the d4 becomes a d6, the d6 becomes a d8, and so on until the die becomes a d20, at which point the target becomes unconscious for 1 hour. The effect then ends. When an oblex causes a target to become memory drained, the oblex learns all the languages the target knows and gains all its proficiencies, except for any saving throw proficiencies.

monsters.name: Oblex Spawn
monsters.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this distance), passive Perception 10

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: The oblex can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Aversion to Fire
traits.desc: If the oblex takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) psychic damage.

monsters.name: Elder Oblex
monsters.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this distance), passive Perception 11

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.desc: The oblex can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

traits.name: Aversion to Fire
traits.desc: If the oblex takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The oblex's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 18). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: charm person (as 5th-level spell), detect thoughts, hold person
3/day each: confusion, dimension door, dominate person, fear, hallucinatory terrain, hold monster, hypnotic pattern, telekinesis

traits.name: Sulfurous Impersonation
traits.desc: As a bonus action, the oblex can extrude a piece of itself that assumes the appearance of one Medium or smaller creature whose memories it has stolen. This simulacrum appears, feels, and sounds exactly like the creature it impersonates, though it smells faintly of sulfur. The oblex can impersonate 2d6 + 1 different creatures, each one tethered to its body by a strand of slime that can extend up to 120 feet away. For all practical purposes, the simulacrum is the oblex, meaning the oblex occupies its space and the simulacrum's space simultaneously. The slimy tether is immune to damage, but it is severed if there is no opening at least 1 inch wide between the oblex's main body and the simulacrum. The simulacrum disappears if the tether is severed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The elder oblex makes two Pseudopod attacks and uses Eat Memories.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (4d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Eat Memories
actions.desc: The oblex targets one creature it can see within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or take 44 (8d10) psychic damage and become memory drained until it finishes a short or long rest or until it benefits from the greater restoration or heal spell. Constructs, oozes, plants, and undead succeed on the save automatically. While memory drained, the target must roll a d4 and subtract the number rolled from any ability check or attack roll it makes. Each time the target is memory drained beyond the first, the die size increases by one: the d4 becomes a d6, the d6 becomes a d8, and so on until the die becomes a d20, at which point the target becomes unconscious for 1 hour. The effect then ends. When an oblex causes a target to become memory drained, the oblex learns all the languages the target knows and gains all its proficiencies, except any saving throw proficiencies.
